title: Expectation of mixed biased monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p_i\in(0,1)$ for each coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S,T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For independent random signs whose coordinate $i$ has mean $1-2p_i$, the expectation of the ordinary sign monomial on $T$ times the monomial formed on $S$ from signs centered by their respective means and divided by their standard deviations is $\left(\prod_{i\in S}2\sqrt{p_i(1-p_i)}\right)\left(\prod_{i\in T\setminus S}(1-2p_i)\right)$ when $S\subseteq T$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ and $T$ are finite subsets of the $n$ coordinates
